description: Look up any paper size — A0 to A6, Letter, Legal, Tabloid — in millimetres, centimetres and inches, plus area and pixel dimensions at your chosen DPI.

faqs.q: Why does each A size halve the previous one?
faqs.a: The ISO 216 A series is built so that cutting a sheet in half across its long side gives the next size down with the same √2 aspect ratio. A0 is defined as exactly 1 m².

faqs.q: What are the exact dimensions of A4?
faqs.a: 210 × 297 mm (8.27 × 11.69 in). It is the world's most common office paper size.
Pixels = inches × DPI. A4 at 300 DPI is (210/25.4)×300 ≈ 2480 × 3508 px — the standard print-ready size.

howto: Choose a paper size (A0–A6, Letter, Legal or Tabloid).
Optionally set your print DPI (300 is standard for print).
Read the dimensions in mm, cm and inches instantly.
Use the pixel dimensions when exporting print-ready artwork.
title: Paper Size Converter
